title: Everything We Learned From Drake’s 9th Anniversary Stake Livestream
summary: Barking for a "goth baddie," a message for the rap game and plenty more came from the 6 God's latest side quest.
contentText:
Drake completed another sidequest over the weekend when he hosted gambling company Stake’s 9th anniversary livestream on Saturday (Aug. 8), which continued Drizzy’s foray into the streaming world.

The 6 God called on NELK Boys co-founder Kyle Forgeard to host a 20-vs.-1 speed-dating show for Drake as part of the stream, which was whittled down to three women with whom Drizzy played a game of “wife, pipe, bestie.” However, it was the clip of Drake barking on command to a “goth baddie” streamer that took the internet by storm.

Drake then jumped around to cover plenty of ground throughout the livestream, which saw him kicking it with streamer BenDaDon, showing love to Tate McRae, sending a warning to the rap game, explaining why he hates his kind gestures being associated with the term “tricking” — and even taking a shot at Roc Nation.

“My second 20 V 1 was almost as lit as the first,” Drake captioned a photodump on IG from the livestream, while calling back to his 2024 battle with Kendrick Lamar.

The OVO rapper’s been in a generous mood lately. He hosted his third annual Strong Women, Stronger Drinks event earlier in August, which saw him gifting women cash prizes along with new cars and designer bags. He also blessed one Stake stream viewer with $50,000 for tuning in.

On the music front, Drake delivered his ICEMAN , HABIBTI and MAID OF HONOUR trifecta in May, which made Drizzy the first to debut albums simultaneously in the top three slots of the Billboard 200.

Drake appears to be continuing his partnership with Stake, as he teased a 10th anniversary stream with the gambling company possibly taking place on a yacht in 2027.
